audience: event organizers and marketers who publish events and calendars with AddEvent

useCases.title: List upcoming events and their dates
useCases.text: Searches events by calendar, text or date and shows title, start and end, timezone, location and RSVP settings. One event can be opened in full.

useCases.title: See who has RSVP'd to an event
useCases.text: Lists RSVP attendees for a calendar or event, filtered by response (going, maybe, not going), with their email and form answers.

useCases.title: Check our calendars and their subscribers
useCases.text: Lists calendars with timezone and counts of events and subscribers, opens one calendar, and lists the people subscribed to the calendars.

useCases.title: Create or update an event
useCases.text: Creates an event on a calendar with a timezone, RSVP form and landing page template, or changes fields of an existing event. Changes go live on its landing page.

useCases.title: Create or update a calendar
useCases.text: Creates a new calendar with a title, or changes the title, description or timezone of an existing one. Changes show on its landing page.

useCases.title: Add or update an RSVP attendee
useCases.text: Adds one RSVP attendee to an event by email, or changes an attendee's email, response or form answers.
